title: One failed chat-history open lasts the page's life: later turns are not saved to the cloud history file and nothing is reported, and the list and thread reads fall through to the server path
evidence: Survey 2026-11-12 (main 5187412d5); Fable ruled 2026-11-12: never the server path while a history layer exists; say Chat history unavailable; retry the open on the next turn; report the missing turn (US-15 AC47). The UI thread builds it after its chat PRs (shared chat-api.ts). widget-src/src/lib/chat-history-access.ts getChatHistory keeps a rejected session; lib/chat-api.ts store?.recordExchange skips with no report. Also useChatState loadConversationsIfNeeded never retries a failed list
